D.t: Ben Ray Luján leads by 24.7 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 202,345 votes; a one point swing is about 4,093 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +16.5 and D +32.8. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is D +16.1. Your best recent poll is SurveyUSA for KOB 4 at D +17.4; your worst is Research & Polling Inc. at D +17.0. 2 polls in the last 30 days.
